note: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/drivers/adc/adc_emul.c#L420: the Adc sampler thread (adapters/adc/sampler.c) calls adc_read_dt -> adc_read -> z_impl_adc_read (inline, CONFIG_USERSPACE=n) -> the emulated driver's read; adc_emul_read_common, adc_emul_start_read, adc_context_lock/start_read/wait_for_completion (drivers/adc/adc_context.h) are inlined into it; the deepest branch is the wait for completion, k_sem_take(&ctx->sync, K_FOREVER). Two branches are off this path by a fact about the caller and one about the configuration, not about the driver: adc_context_start_read takes adc_context_enable_timer -> k_timer_start -> z_add_timeout only when sequence->options is non-NULL and interval_us != 0, and the sampler's sequence has options == NULL (adapters/adc/sampler.c zero-initialises it; adc_sequence_init_dt does not set it), so giving the sampler an options structure would put an unattested path under this row; and CONFIG_LOG=n keeps the driver's LOG_ERR callees (z_log_msg_*) off it

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/kernel/sem.c#L132: k_sem_take with K_FOREVER; the lock's k_sem_take in adc_context_lock is the same depth from a shallower caller

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90/kernel/sched.c#L691: pends the thread (pend_locked inlined; no z_add_timeout for K_FOREVER) and z_swap -> arch_swap (inline) pends PendSV; the switch is thread_switch. The emulator's acquisition thread (CONFIG_ADC_EMUL_ACQUISITION_THREAD_STACK_SIZE) is Zephyr's own thread on its own stack, not this path
